translations.web: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
translations.bsb: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
translations.kjv: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
translations.asv: And it is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating upon their breasts.
